packageRules.description: Jellyfin packages: stay on the oldest supported Jellyfin (12.1); a plugin built against newer packages does not load on older servers
Jellyfin packages: automerge patch updates; the merge is released automatically (.woodpecker/auto_release.yaml)
CI .NET SDK: stay on the major version of the plugin's target framework (net10.0, required by Jellyfin 12); move SDK, target framework and Jellyfin packages together
